premise: On a cosy dark night Owl and Raccoon notice a soft light in the moss; it is Mushroom, glowing and shy about it; they tell her she is the only light in the forest tonight, and she lets it grow.
inspiration: The Little Candle folk motif (a small light that thinks it does not matter), turned: the small light is celebrated and lights the way home.
lesson: A small light matters most when it is the only one.

en-US.title: Mushroom Glows
en-US.text: {sfx:night} [whispers] It was a soft, dark, cosy night. Raccoon {raccoon:pulse} was on their way home. And down in the moss, something was glowing. A small green light, like a lantern for ants. [curious] What is that? said Owl. {owl:pulse} They crept closer. {raccoon:hop} The light got shyer. It dimmed… almost out… [surprised] Oh! said Raccoon. It is Mushroom! Mushroom {mushroom:glow #C8FFB0 hold} went pink under her glow. I did not mean to, she said. It happens at night. I try to keep it small. Keep it small? said Frog, {frog:hop} plopping up. Why? Because it is only me, said Mushroom. Only you? said Owl. {owl:wobble} You are the only light in the whole forest tonight. [softly] And slowly, Mushroom let her glow grow. {mushroom:glow #C8FFB0 2s hold} Green and gentle and just bright enough. [happily] And Owl sat on his branch all night, keeping the smallest night-light in the world company.

es-ES.title: Seta brilla
es-ES.text: {sfx:night} [whispers] Era una noche suave, oscura y acogedora. Mapache {raccoon:pulse} volvía a casa. Y abajo, en el musgo, algo brillaba. Una lucecita verde, como un farolillo para hormigas. [curious] ¿Qué es eso?, dijo Búho. {owl:pulse} Se acercaron despacito. {raccoon:hop} La luz se volvió tímida. Bajó… casi se apagó… [surprised] ¡Oh!, dijo Mapache. ¡Es Seta! Seta {mushroom:glow #C8FFB0 hold} se puso colorada debajo de su brillo. No lo hago aposta, dijo. Intento que sea pequeñito. ¿Pequeñito?, dijo Rana, {frog:hop} asomando de un salto. ¿Por qué? Porque solo soy yo, dijo Seta. ¿Solo tú?, dijo Búho. {owl:wobble} Eres la única luz de todo el bosque esta noche. [softly] Y despacio, Seta dejó crecer su brillo. {mushroom:glow #C8FFB0 2s hold} Verde, suave y justo lo bastante claro. [happily] Y Búho se quedó en su rama toda la noche, haciendo compañía a la lucecita más pequeña del mundo.

night.prompt: a calm moonless forest night, soft crickets and a faint breeze, cosy and still
